package nifixture_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/unicitynetwork/bft-go-base/types"

	"github.com/unicitynetwork/aggregator-go/internal/nifixture"
	"github.com/unicitynetwork/aggregator-go/pkg/api"
	"github.com/unicitynetwork/aggregator-go/pkg/noninclusion"
)

type dumpCase struct {
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	Bits     int    `json:"authorityBits"`
	Shard    string `json:"contextShard"`
	UCShard  string `json:"ucShard"`
	Query    string `json:"query"`
	Wrapper  string `json:"wrapper"`
	Expected string `json:"expected"`
}

func keyIn(bits, idx int, tag string) []byte {
	h := sha256.Sum256([]byte(tag))
	k := h[:]
	for b := 0; b < bits; b++ {
		want := (idx >> (bits - 1 - b)) & 1
		k[b/8] = k[b/8]&^(0x80>>(b%8)) | byte(want)<<(7-b%8)
	}
	return k
}

func TestDumpSharded(t *testing.T) {
	out := map[string]any{"partition": uint64(nifixture.Partition)}
	tbs := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
	var cases []dumpCase
	for _, bits := range []int{2, 3} {
		auth, err := nifixture.NewShardedAuthority(bits)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		tbj, err := json.MarshalIndent(auth.TrustBase(), "", "  ")
		require.NoError(t, err)
		tbs[fmt.Sprint(bits)] = tbj
		n := 1 << bits
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			shard := auth.ShardID(i)
			sets := map[string][]int{"one": {i}, "two": {i, i}, "three": {i, i, i}, "foreign": {(i + 1) % n, (i + 1) % n}}
			for _, setName := range []string{"one", "two", "three", "foreign"} {
				var leaves []nifixture.Leaf
				for j, owner := range sets[setName] {
					var l nifixture.Leaf
					copy(l.Key[:], keyIn(bits, owner, fmt.Sprintf("leaf-%d-%d-%s-%d", bits, i, setName, j)))
					copy(l.Value[:], bytes.Repeat([]byte{byte(j + 1)}, 32))
					leaves = append(leaves, l)
				}
				tree, err := nifixture.Build(leaves)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				root, _ := tree.Root()
				uc, _, err := auth.CertifyShardRoot(i, root[:])
				require.NoError(t, err)
				ucb, err := uc.MarshalCBOR()
				require.NoError(t, err)
				queries := map[string][]byte{}
				for q := 0; q < 2; q++ {
					queries[fmt.Sprintf("absent%d", q)] = keyIn(bits, i, fmt.Sprintf("q-%d-%d-%s-%d", bits, i, setName, q))
				}
				for j, l := range leaves {
					queries[fmt.Sprintf("leaf%d", j)] = l.Key[:]
				}
				for o := 0; o < n; o++ {
					if o != i {
						queries[fmt.Sprintf("outside%d", o)] = keyIn(bits, o, fmt.Sprintf("o-%d-%d-%s-%d", bits, i, setName, o))
					}
				}
				ctxs := map[string]types.ShardID{"own": shard, "other": auth.ShardID((i + 1) % n), "unsharded": {}}
				for qn, q := range queries {
					wrapper := nifixture.EncodeWrapper(100, tree.Certificate([32]byte(q)), ucb)
					for cn, cshard := range ctxs {
						tb := auth.TrustBase()
						v, err := noninclusion.NewVerifier(noninclusion.Context{Partition: nifixture.Partition, Shard: cshard,
							Resolver: func(*types.UnicitySeal) (types.RootTrustBase, error) { return tb, nil }})
						require.NoError(t, err)
						var c api.NonInclusionCert
						require.NoError(t, c.UnmarshalBinary(tree.Certificate([32]byte(q))))
						p := &api.NonInclusionProofV1{Certificate: &c, UnicityCertificate: types.RawCBOR(ucb)}
						_, verr := v.VerifyFor(q, p)
						cases = append(cases, dumpCase{
							Name: fmt.Sprintf("b%d-s%d-%s-%s-%s", bits, i, setName, qn, cn), Bits: bits, Shard: cshard.String(), UCShard: shard.String(),
							Query: hex.EncodeToString(q), Wrapper: hex.EncodeToString(wrapper), Expected: noninclusion.VerdictOf(verr)})
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	out["trustBases"] = tbs
	out["cases"] = cases
	b, err := json.Marshal(out)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("DUMP_OUT"), b, 0o644))
}
